item.title: Metro Council weighs siting rule changes ahead of summer recess
item.author: newsroom@wweek.com
item.description: The regional government took up proposed changes to energy facility siting review this week, with a work session that adopted an amendment to the review timeline. Councilors heard testimony from utility representatives, neighborhood associations and two county planning departments over roughly three hours before adjourning without a final vote on the underlying measure.

item.title: Clark County committee reports Oregon-based contribution
item.author: newsroom@wweek.com
item.description: A candidate committee in Clark County reported a contribution originating from a political committee registered in Oregon, according to a filing received by the Washington Public Disclosure Commission. Cross-border contributions are permitted under Washington law and are reported through the same disclosure system as in-state receipts. The filing lists the contribution date as the twenty-fifth of May.
